data: What is the approximate value of the yellow line at 80% of training examples in the left plot?

The left plot shows the F1 scores of BERT-NCE and INFOWORD as we increase the percentage of training examples on SQuAD (dev). The yellow line represents INFOWORD, and the blue line represents BERT-NCE. The question asks for the approximate value of the yellow line at 80% of training examples.

Looking at the left plot, the yellow line (INFOWORD) reaches approximately 89 at 80% of training examples. Therefore, the approximate value of the yellow line at 80% of training examples is 89.
